name: symfony
readmeHtml:
Symfony is a PHP framework for web and console applications and a set of reusable PHP components. Symfony is used by thousands of web applications and most of the popular PHP projects.

Installation

  • Install Symfony with Composer (see requirements details).
  • Symfony follows the semantic versioning strictly, publishes "Long Term Support" (LTS) versions and has a release process that is predictable and business-friendly.

Sponsor

Symfony 8.2 is looking for backers.

Help Symfony by sponsoring its development!

Documentation

  • Read the Getting Started guide if you are new to Symfony.
  • Try the Symfony Demo application to learn Symfony in practice.
  • Discover Symfony ecosystem in detail with Symfony The Fast Track.
  • Master Symfony with the Guides and Tutorials, the Components docs and the Best Practices reference.

Community

  • Join the Symfony Community and meet other members at the Symfony events.
  • Get Symfony support on GitHub Discussions, Slack, etc.
  • Follow us on GitHub, Twitter and Facebook.
  • Read our Code of Conduct and meet the CARE Team.

Contributing

Symfony is an Open Source, community-driven project with thousands of contributors. Join them contributing code or contributing documentation.

Security Issues

If you discover a security vulnerability within Symfony, please follow our disclosure procedure.

About Us

Symfony development is led by the Symfony Core Team and supported by Symfony contributors.

aiSummary.oneLiner: A set of reusable PHP components and a full-stack web framework.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: Symfony is a set of reusable PHP components and a PHP framework to build web applications, APIs, microservices and web services. It aims to speed up the creation and maintenance of web applications and to replace repetitive coding tasks. It is backed by a huge community of developers and provides comprehensive documentation. Many popular PHP projects, like Drupal and Magento, rely heavily on its components.
keyFeatures: Reusable components: Offers dozens of decoupled PHP libraries that can be used independently in any PHP project.
Full-stack framework: Provides a cohesive architecture for building complex, scalable web applications.
Dependency injection container: Manages object lifecycles and dependencies robustly.
Extensive documentation: Features comprehensive guides and API references to support developer onboarding.
Built-in testing tools: Includes integrations with PHPUnit for robust application testing.
Command-line interface: Provides the Console component for creating powerful CLI commands.

useCases.title: Enterprise web applications
useCases.description: Build scalable, long-term business applications with robust architecture.

useCases.description: Create complex web services and APIs with advanced routing and serialization.

useCases.title: Microservice architecture
useCases.description: Develop lightweight microservices utilizing only necessary components.

useCases.title: CMS foundation
useCases.description: Serve as the underlying architecture for content management systems like Drupal.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: PHP developers and enterprise teams building complex, scalable web applications or APIs. It expects a solid understanding of object-oriented programming and design patterns.
